name: Data file clean-up loop
why: Fixes and re-checks a messy file until it passes and saves the rules, the same habit as the profiling and clean-up skill.

name: Excel table join reconciler
why: Joins two tables on a key and reconciles the rows, covering the join counts and unmatched keys this role always reports.

name: Build a weekly KPI report with a forecast and dashboard
why: A rerunnable weekly report with a trend and forecast, a close match to the monthly report refresh workflow.

name: Prepare a survey findings briefing
why: Turns survey results into a checked findings table with sampling caveats, like the survey read-out prompt.

name: Survey answer truth checker
why: Scores how far survey answers can be trusted before they go into a brief.

name: Cohort funnel reader
why: Reads results by join date to see where each group drops off, the cohort side of the insight brief skill.

name: Findings and guesses separator
why: Sorts every line of an analysis into proven, likely or guess, a useful last check before sending a brief.

name: Plan what to make each week from your past sales
why: Puts a sales forecast to work in a weekly production plan, a next step after the forecast skill.

name: Report definition drift review assistant
why: Finds where a recurring report's metric definition changed, a common cause of numbers that suddenly jump.

name: Vanity metric fixer
why: Replaces numbers that look good but explain nothing with per-customer measures that show cause.

name: Weekly numbers sheet designer
why: Designs a one-page sheet of the few numbers an owner should watch each week.
